MRI of right Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

> There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Fatty muscle tranformation  of roght lower thigh
> Some joint effusion of right knee; in favor of infrapatellar plica.
> Suspicious of mild wearing articular cartilage of femur.
> Mild subcutaneous edema over anterior aspect of right knee.
Impression: 
1. C/w tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
2. muscle atrophy of right lower thigh.
3. Some joint effusion of right knee; in favor of infrapatellar plica.
4. R/o grade 2 chondromalacia of femur.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation



Medial meniscus tear

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate right knee joint effusion. Small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Horizontal oblique tear involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, extending at least 3 cm from medial to lateral with associated marked attenuation of the junction of the body and posterior horn of the meniscus and extrusion of the body of the meniscus. This likely represents an unstable medial meniscal tear.

There is some mild associated articular cartilage thinning with some focal denudation of the articular cartilage over the lateral tibial plateau with some associated subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes.

The medial collateral ligament appears intact.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Mild focal cartilage fissuring involving the weightbearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle without subchondral bone changes.

The lateral meniscus and fibular collateral ligament complex appear intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Focal articular cartilage fissuring involving the junction of the lateral patellar facet and median ridge of the patella without subchondral bone changes.
The trochlear articular cartilage appears intact.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Unstable horizontal tear involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with some attenuation of the junction of the body and posterior horn of the meniscus and extrusion of the body of the meniscus.
2.Associated chondrosis involving the medial femorotibial compartment, as described.
3.Patellar fissuring and chondrosis, as described.
4.Moderate right knee joint effusion with a small uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Three-month history medial sided knee pain without specific injury. Pain worse with activity.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Small high-grade partial-thickness focal defect at the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness fissuring central inferior femoral trochlea with mild subchondral marrow edema. Patellar cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2.	Small partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

In den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen, kein Knochenmarksödem, kein bone bruise. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB sowie HKB intakt. MCL sowie LCL intakt. Kein Anhalt für ein Tractus iliotibialis-Syndrom. Deutlicher Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Geringes inferopattelares, subkutanes Hämatom, ansonsten die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Fokaler vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt mit subchdonralem Ödem im posteromedialen Tibiaplateau. Extrusion des Innenmeniskus mit Lappenriss im Hinterhorn mit einerseits in den Gelenkraum sowie auf die Meniskussubstanz umgeschlagenem Flap (Serie 6/ Image 11). Minimal Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenemeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt mit subchondralen Zysten an der superolateralen Patellafacette (Serie 4/ Image 10) sowie der lateralen Trochlea mit hier auch Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patella- und Quadrizepssehne. 

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder. 

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и структура. Не се изобразява костномозъчен едем.   Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е интактен. Предна кръстна връзка се представя с непроменен сигнален интензитет, задната кръстна връзка също е интактна и със запазена цялост. МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус – в задния му рог се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход, достигащща до артикулиращия хрущял ан тибията – стадий 3. Частична руптура и на предния рог на минискус в съчетание с менискусови кисти . Частична увреда и на заден рог на медиален менискус – стадий 2а. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти, като латералния е изместен встрани от подлежащите менискусови кисти. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Нормално изобрлазяване на меките тъкани в лявата колянна става.Заключение: МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус с формиране на менискусови кисти. Частична увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Esguince rodilla derecha.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco medial es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Rotura del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y parte del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral de predominio
marginal con leve extrusión meniscal. Esto se asocia discreto edema las partes blandas
regionales.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral. El resto de los cartílagos
femorotibiales y patelofemorales sin alteraciones.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos de una rotura compleja de predominio marginal del menisco lateral con mínima extrusión y
edema de las partes blandas perimeniscales.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Leve derrame articular.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial knee pain. Positive medial meniscus testing. 
Comparison: [REDACTED]. 

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the right  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  Moderate knee joint effusion. No popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: High-grade radial tear at the posterior horn/root junction. Large degree of peripheral meniscal extrusion, with the meniscus projecting 5 mm beyond the tibial margin. There is also a horizontal tear of the meniscal body and oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  There is full-thickness cartilage loss involving the weightbearing portions of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau, with mild to moderate subchondral bone marrow edema. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Bowing of the ligament secondary to meniscal extrusion. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: Diffuse thinning of the patellar cartilage, with high-grade and small full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial patellar facet. There is also multifocal cartilage fissuring of the lateral patellar facet. Partial-thickness cartilage loss is noted in the central and medial aspect of the trochlea. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tear of the medial meniscus, including radial tear at the posterior horn/root junction, with peripheral extrusion.

2. Moderate medial greater than patellofemoral compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Moderate knee joint effusion.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sospecha de rotura del LCA.
Hallazgos:
Aumento de señal con fenómenos que sugieran pérdida parcial de la continuidad de las fibras proximales,
probablemente posterolaterales de LCA con parcial horizontalización de fibras. Mínimo edema óseo del
aspecto posterior de platillo tibial lateral.
LCP y ligamentos colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal del meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales
de espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano de distribución difusa.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del tendón
rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Signos sugerentes de una lesión parcial del aspecto proximal del LCA, con parcial horizontalización de sus
fibras, hallazgos que podrían estar fenómenos cicatriciales en evolución, correlacionar con antecedentes.
Mínimo edema óseo del aspecto posterior de platillo tibial lateral.
Aumento de señal de la región meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que podría
representar lesión parcial regional.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de hiperpresión externa de la rótula

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco medial de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y parte del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral con
componente principal horizontal oblicuo asociado a pequeños quistes para meniscales de
predominio anterior, polilobulados que en su conjunto miden aproximadamente 19 x 10 mm en sus
ejes mayores.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la zona de carga del compartimento
femorotibial lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial medial y patelofemoral sin alteraciones. No hay
significativo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y parte del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral con
pequeños quistes para meniscales regionales.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
